# Burak Başal / Burak Basal

> Developer. Software, interfaces, real-time systems and browser games.

Official site: https://burakbasal.github.io/
Repository: https://github.com/burakbasal/burakbasal.github.io

## Selected work
- Roamcroft — isometric real-time 3D farming and exploration; https://roamcroft.com/
- satkolay — second-hand marketplace (currently maintenance mode); https://satkolay.com/
- endless-wordle — unlimited Wordle-style game; https://burakbasal.github.io/endless-wordle/
- wall-race — strategy game with local multiplayer; https://burakbasal.github.io/wall-race/
- rezonans — interactive browser experience; https://burakbasal.github.io/rezonans/
- Global Bilgi · CallSim — Turkish call-centre simulation; https://gbsim.pages.dev/

## Verified facts
- Turkish name: Burak Başal. English name: Burak Basal. Professional title: Developer.
- All six projects were designed and built solo.
- Education: Vocational & Technical Anatolian High School, Information Technologies / Software Development.
- Certificates: CCNA Introduction to Networks, CyberOps Associate, Ethical Hacker.
- Languages on the official site: Turkish and English.
- Contact and verified profiles are listed on the official site.
- Private source repositories are not published; only their public demos are linked.
